title: Grateful Dead Live at Greek Theatre - University of California on 1982-05-21
source: SBD -> Cassette Master (Sony TC-D5M) -> Dat -> CD

ai_review.summary: Crisp soundboard capture of a charming, high‑energy May ’82 show with standout Black Peter and a tight second set.
ai_review.review: The recording is praised for its crystal‑clear, full‑spectrum sound (likely a Sony D‑5 soundboard source) with only minor low‑end distortion. Musically the concert delivers a happy, concise second set packed with great jams, highlighted by an especially memorable Black Peter and a punchy drum solo.

ai_rating.rationale: All five reviews are strongly positive (four 5‑star, one 4‑star) and emphasize both an excellent performance and high‑quality recording.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crisp, full‑spectrum sound from a Sony D‑5; minor low‑end distortion noted but otherwise clean and well balanced.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Short, concise second set with no wasted moments; jams flow smoothly and keep the energy high.

band_member_comments.Drums: Drum solo highlighted as strong and energetic.
